puzzles.name: Kropki Sudoku
puzzles.description: Use the black and white dots between cells to work out consecutive and double-value pairs.

puzzles.name: Hyper Sudoku
puzzles.description: Classic Sudoku with four extra shaded regions that must also contain the digits 1 to 9.

puzzles.name: Anti-King Sudoku
puzzles.description: Solve the grid while making sure matching digits never touch diagonally like a king in chess.

puzzles.name: Anti-Knight Sudoku
puzzles.description: Standard Sudoku with one extra rule: matching digits cannot be a knight's move apart.

puzzles.name: Non-Consecutive Sudoku
puzzles.description: Orthogonally adjacent cells cannot contain consecutive numbers, adding another layer of deduction.

puzzles.name: Odds and Evens Sudoku
puzzles.description: Use the marked odd and even cells alongside the normal Sudoku rules to complete the grid.

puzzles.name: Sudoku X
puzzles.description: Both main diagonals must contain the digits 1 to 9 as well as every row, column and box.

puzzles.name: Arrow Sudoku
puzzles.description: Each circled digit equals the total of the digits running along its arrow.

puzzles.name: German Whispers Sudoku
puzzles.description: Neighbouring digits along each whisper line must differ by at least five.

puzzles.name: Killer Sudoku
puzzles.description: Use the cage totals together with standard Sudoku logic to place every digit.

puzzles.name: Little Killer Sudoku
puzzles.description: Outside clues give diagonal sums, combining Sudoku logic with arithmetic deduction.

puzzles.name: Renban Sudoku
puzzles.description: Digits on each Renban line form a set of consecutive numbers in any order.

puzzles.name: Sandwich Sudoku
puzzles.description: Outside clues show the sum of the digits sitting between 1 and 9 in each row or column.

puzzles.name: Thermo Sudoku
puzzles.description: Digits increase along every thermometer from the bulb towards the tip.

puzzles.name: XV Sudoku
puzzles.description: Use the V and X clues between neighbouring cells to identify pairs that total 5 or 10.

puzzles.name: Trigoku
puzzles.description: A Sapiver number puzzle with a fresh daily challenge and a different route to the solution.

otherGames.name: Sapiver Duel
otherGames.description: Test your judgement in a quick timeline-based duel game.
